messages:
olivia: Kicking off tri-region cutover for v2.3.0 in ~2h (02:00 UTC). Need a final capacity sanity check and agree rollback triggers + pin strategy. @ben @maria @kevin

deploy-bot: Scheduled: v2.3.0 -> production @ 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. Canary window: 15m. Run `/deploy status 1729992468` for live progress. CI: smoke ✅, integration ✅, perf smoke ✅

ben: Running a quick capacity probe across US/EU/APAC right now. Will post condensed output.

ben: ```
$ ./tools/capacity-check --regions us,eu,apac --pool model=rdx-gpt-8-seq128
US  : headroom 75%  (gpu util 42%)
EU  : headroom 60%  (gpu util 52%)
APAC: headroom 35%  (gpu util 68%)  <-- borderline, trending up under burst
```

maria: Thanks. Suggestion: pin APAC to canary variant for 15m and pre-warm +2 reserved nodes in apac before ramp. US/EU can proceed with normal staged ramp if metrics stable.

kevin: I already queued an autoscale override for apac: +2 reserved nodes at T-10m. Also setting a temporary throttling rule: max ramp rate 10%/3m for APAC until we hit 50% headroom. Rollback triggers I'm proposing: error rate +5% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency > 800ms for 5m. Approve?

olivia: Approve rollback triggers. For pins: APAC pinned to v2.3.0-canary for first 15m; EU pinned to v2.3.0-canary for first 10m; US no pin (full path) but throttled ramp. If APAC doesn't clear 45% headroom within 20m, we revert APAC to v2.2.9.

ben: Noted. Quick sanity on model variants: v2.3.0-canary uses q4x quant, older v2.2.9 runs q8-flex. Perf differences measured ~8% throughput improvement on v2.3 but slightly higher mem.

deploy-bot: Canary kick: routing 2% traffic -> each region canary slice. Monitoring: infra, errors, latency, token-cost delta. I will post metric readouts every 2m.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ +4m: US ok (errors 0.02%, p95 180ms), EU ok (errors 0.03%, p95 210ms), APAC warning (errors 0.04%, p95 420ms, gpu util 74%).

kevin: Seeing APAC GPU climb; autoscale override active. Changing canary ramp for APAC to 1% per 4m until util < 60%.

maria: I'll hold public release notes until APAC stabilizes. Internal release note draft: "v2.3.0 — improved KV cache behavior, kernel selection improvements for long contexts, and inference memory optimizations. Canaries enabled per-region."

olivia: Quick checklist before we open full slices: 1) APAC reserved +2 nodes live, 2) rollback triggers set, 3) pin policy documented, 4) oncall + watch windows pinned. Confirm with short ack.

ben: 1/4 APAC nodes live, 2/4 rollback triggers in infra, 3/4 pin policy documented in deploy ticket, 4/4 oncall aware.

kevin: ack. I'll watch APAC for first 30m. If gpu util > 85% or p95 > 800ms we pin and rollback that region.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ +14m: US green, EU green, APAC borderline but stable (errors 0.05%, p95 460ms, gpu util 78%). No rollback triggered.

olivia: Given metrics, proceed with staged ramp: US -> 40% over next 20m, EU -> 30% over next 20m, APAC -> remain at canary (+ reserve) and evaluate at +30m.

maria: I'll push the customer-facing release note after confirmation at +30m. Draft: "Incremental rollout of v2.3.0 to improve long-context performance; monitoring in place. No expected breaking changes"

ben: small log snippet from APAC during canary: `2026-03-22T02:14:05Z WARN kernel-select: fallback to slower kernel for shard-3 due to mem pressure` — tracked and tied to util spikes.

kevin: Noted. I set a transient fallback policy: if mem pressure persists for 2m fallback APAC shards to v2.2.9 automatically (soft rollback).

olivia: Good. We'll keep this thread as the single source-of-truth for roll decisions. If APAC auto-falls back, ops will file a rollback postmortem.

deploy-bot: Full roll command executed for US/EU ramp per plan at +18m. APAC remains pinned to canary.

deploy-bot: Final status @ +32m: US 45% traffic, EU 32% traffic, APAC 2% canary (p95 470ms, errors 0.05%). No manual rollback.

maria: ack — I'll publish the external note now with a short blurb and a pointer to status dashboard. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Staying on watch for next 30m. If anything, we'll flip APAC back to v2.2.9 and open a hotfix ticket for memory path.

olivia: Thanks all — closing the cutover thread. If anything changes, update here and tag @olivia. :rocket:
